skill-creator.use: The builder. building-skills follows its workflow for drafting, test runs, the review viewer and benchmarks.

superpowers-writing-skills.use: TDD for skills: baseline pressure tests, matching the form of guidance to the failure, closing rationalisations.

skill-judge.use: A scoring rubric for skill design (knowledge delta, freedom, anti-patterns). The skill-reviewer agent uses parts of it.

plugin-dev.use: Anthropic's plugin-development guides and reviewer agents, for skills that ship inside plugins with hooks.

task-observer.use: An always-on observer that logs corrections from real sessions and turns them into skill improvements. improving-skills borrows its method; install it separately to run it.

agentskills-docs.use: The Agent Skills open standard and its authoring, evaluation and description-optimisation guides.
